title: [Main] Expense Management: make Expense Management Setup public; keep agent and corporate card surface internal
summary: Table 6930 Expense Agent Setup, which holds company-wide expense management settings, is now public so extensions can read and maintain those settings. Agent, mailbox, notification, policy and corporate card fields stay internal at field level, and the corporate card interface, table, enums and fields are made internal.
key_points: Expense Agent Setup table made public for expense management settings such as number series, rules, currency, mileage and per diem
Agent, communication, notification, policy evaluation, approval workflow and corporate card fields kept internal at field level
Corporate card provider interface, statement table, enums and table extension fields made internal
Expense Exchange Rate, Exp. Full Per Diem Calculation and Expense Partial Day Rules enums made accessible and non-extensible
Extensions can read the default-setup Applied flags and set them so the setup wizard does not overwrite their data
